title: urostigma trigonum
intro: Urostigma trigonum, commonly known as the Indian gentian, is a plant species that belongs to the family Gentianaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Urostigma trigonum include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, making it useful for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside and amarogentin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
